instruction: Run `C:\Users\user\Desktop\sallen_key.cir` in native PSpice. Keep the native simulator artifacts as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\sallen_key.out`, `C:\Users\user\Desktop\sallen_key_measure.txt`, and `C:\Users\user\Desktop\sallen_key.dat`. Then read the nine corner measurement blocks from `C:\Users\user\Desktop\sallen_key_measure.txt` and write `C:\Users\user\Desktop\wc.json` with `BW_nominal`, `BW_min`, `BW_max`, `corner_min`, and `corner_max`, where each `BW_*` value is the highest sampled frequency that remains within 3 dB of that corner's peak sample. [Software] Launch OrCAD Capture with `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\capture.exe` (adjust to your Cadence install root).
